steps.text: Tip the beans into a small pan and warm them over a medium heat, stirring now and then.
steps.done_cue: Gently bubbling at the edges and steaming.

steps.text: Toast the bread while the beans warm.
steps.done_cue: Golden brown and crisp all over.

steps.text: Butter the toast, pile the beans on top, then finish with the cheddar and a twist of pepper.
steps.done_cue: The cheese has started to melt into the beans.
